svg.aria-label: The Octonary mark: eight segments, even gaps, a rightward curl and a hooked tip
svg.title: The mark

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Hiragino Sans GB', 'Microsoft YaHei', 'Noto Sans SC', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: A nod to the name Octonary. Each segment is about 10% shorter than the last.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Hiragino Sans GB', 'Microsoft YaHei', 'Noto Sans SC', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: Equal spacing between segments, with angled cuts that read as joints.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Hiragino Sans GB', 'Microsoft YaHei', 'Noto Sans SC', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: Rises from the base and curls harder toward the tip, about 275° in total.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Hiragino Sans GB', 'Microsoft YaHei', 'Noto Sans SC', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: The last two segments hook back toward the stem: grasp, wrap, retract.
